name: Wright's Orchard and Dried Flower Farm
tagline: Wright's Orchard and Dried Flower Farm at https://www.wrightsorchard.com
description: In 271 South River Road, CT, Wright's Orchard and Dried Flower Farm grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples on a small apple orchard. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. The season runs through spring, summer, and autumn. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
